## onboarding_case

One pre-boarding/onboarding case per new hire (1:1 with Employee for the NEW_HIRE cohort).

Lifecycle: `OPEN -> IN_PROGRESS -> COMPLETED; OPEN|IN_PROGRESS -> CANCELLED (offer withdrawn)`

| Field | Type | Required | Allowed values / format | Units | Unique | Key | Validation rule | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `onboarding_case_id` | str(40) | yes | `^ONB-\d{4}-\d{6}$` |  | yes | PK |  | Primary key. |
| `employee_id` | str(40) | yes |  |  | yes | FK → `employee.employee_id` |  | Hire. |
| `manager_id` | str(40) | yes |  |  |  | FK → `manager.manager_id` |  | Hiring manager (approves access). |
| `hr_partner_id` | str(40) | yes |  |  |  | FK → `employee.employee_id` |  | HR partner owning the case. |
| `it_partner_id` | str(40) | yes |  |  |  | FK → `employee.employee_id` |  | IT/operations partner provisioning access and equipment. |
| `case_created_date` | date | yes |  |  |  |  |  | Case opened (offer accepted). |
| `original_start_date` | date | yes |  |  |  |  | >= case_created_date | Start date at offer. |
| `planned_start_date` | date | yes |  |  |  |  | = last START_DATE_CHANGED event, else original_start_date | Latest agreed start date. **Derived.** |
| `actual_start_date` | date | no |  |  |  |  | <= as_of_date | First day worked (null if not started). |
| `cancelled_date` | date | no |  |  |  |  | < original_start_date; actual_start_date is null | Offer withdrawn (case cancelled). |
| `start_delay_days` | int | yes |  | days |  |  | >= 0 | Planned minus original start. **Derived.** |
| `total_tasks` | int | yes |  | count |  |  |  | Number of tasks on the case. **Derived.** |
| `completed_tasks` | int | yes |  | count |  |  | <= total_tasks | Number of COMPLETED tasks. **Derived.** |
| `completion_pct` | decimal | yes |  | percent |  |  | 0..100, 2 dp | completed_tasks / total_tasks * 100. **Derived.** |
| `case_status` | str(40) | yes | `OPEN`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `COMPLETED`, `CANCELLED` |  |  |  |  | Lifecycle status. **Derived.** |
| `case_completed_date` | date | no |  |  |  |  |  | Date last task completed. **Derived.** |

| `event_type` | str(40) | yes | `EMPLOYEE_HIRED`, `EMPLOYEE_STARTED`, `EMPLOYEE_TERMINATED`, `OFFER_WITHDRAWN`, `ROLE_CHANGED`, `START_DATE_CHANGED`, `CASE_CREATED`, `CASE_COMPLETED`, `CASE_CANCELLED`, `TASK_STARTED`, `TASK_COMPLETED`, `TASK_CANCELLED`, `GRANT_REQUESTED`, `GRANT_APPROVED`, `GRANT_REJECTED`, `GRANT_PROVISIONED`, `GRANT_REVOKED`, `GRANT_CANCELLED`, `ACCESS_OVERRIDE_APPROVED`, `ASSET_PURCHASED`, `ASSET_ASSIGNED`, `ASSET_DELIVERED`, `ASSET_ACKNOWLEDGED`, `ASSET_RETURNED`, `ASSET_LOST`, `ASSET_RETIRED` |  |  |  |  | What happened. |
| `actor_id` | str(40) | no |  |  |  | FK → `employee.employee_id` |  | Employee who acted (null for SYSTEM). |
| `actor_role` | str(40) | yes | `EMPLOYEE`, `MANAGER`, `HR_PARTNER`, `IT_OPS_PARTNER`, `SYSTEM_ADMIN`, `SYSTEM` |  |  |  |  | Capacity the actor acted in. |
| `from_state` | str(40) | no |  |  |  |  |  | State before. |
| `to_state` | str(40) | no |  |  |  |  |  | State after. |
| `related_case_id` | str(60) | no |  |  |  |  |  | Onboarding/offboarding case context. |
| `reason` | str(200) | no |  |  |  |  |  | Free-text justification. |
